title: x-display presentation hints
description: Closed vocabulary (D-13) for the config_schema's x-display extension. Any property in a connector's config_schema (contract.md, "Spec document", D-12) may carry one of these objects under its own "x-display" key. additionalProperties is false: an unrecognized hint key is a publish-time schema-authoring error, not a silently-ignored typo.

label.description: Human-readable field label for form rendering.

group.description: Groups fields under a shared heading in generated forms.

order.description: Sort position within a group; lower values render first.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown in an empty input.

hidden.description: Field exists in the schema and config document but is not rendered in a form. Config-document rules (D-2, D-14) still apply in full — hidden is a rendering hint only.

secret.description: The field's ENTIRE value is a secret:// reference (D-4) — resolution requires the whole string to start with the prefix; there is no partial/mid-string resolution. Mutually exclusive with secret_parts (enforced by this schema's root `not`): a field is either a whole-value secret reference, or a plain value that may get UI display-masking on named components, never both.

secret_parts.description: Display-masking only — this hint never causes secret:// substitution inside a value (a whole-value secret:// reference in the field still resolves under config.md's document-wide rule). It marks which URL component(s) of a composite value, such as a connection URI, a rendering client should mask from view. A field needing a real, resolvable credential inside a composite value decomposes that credential into its own `secret: true` leaf field instead (see config.md's worked example); this hint does not make that unnecessary. Mutually exclusive with secret (enforced by this schema's root `not`).

visible_when.description: Map of fieldName -> required value. The field carrying this hint is shown in a rendered form only while every named field currently holds the given value. Conditional JSON Schema validation (allOf/if/then) is DERIVED from this map by generators — schema authors never hand-write the equivalent allOf themselves (D-13).

cp-type.description: Marks the field as naming a NATS resource of this kind, enabling control-plane affordances (e.g. a stream picker) for the field.

code.description: Field is rendered as a multiline code editor instead of a single-line input.
